entities.summary: Duncan McLauchlin "Lauch" Faircloth was an American politician from North Carolina who served as a Republican member of the United States Senate for one term from 1993 to 1999. He was a member of the Democratic Party for most of his career in North Carolina politics until he joined the Republican Party in 1991.
